title: Ramsden Road in Wardle to close for Christmas Eve carol concert
excerpt: Part of Ramsden Road in Wardle will close from 5.30pm to 7.30pm on Thursday 24 December 2026 for the Wardle Village Christmas Eve Carol Concert. There will be no alternative route for vehicles.
image_alt: Illustration: Wardle, traffic. Not a photograph of the event.

corrections.note: Corrected on 12 November 2026: an earlier version said a Rochdale Borough Council spokesperson had commented on the closure. The council's notice contains no such statement, and the sentence has been removed.

body:
Part of Ramsden Road in Wardle will be closed on Christmas Eve for the Wardle Village Christmas Eve Carol Concert.

The road will be closed between its junctions with Crossfield Road and Wardle Fold from 5.30pm to 7.30pm on Thursday 24 December 2026.

Rochdale Borough Council, which is organising the closure, says there will be no alternative route for vehicles.

The council's notice, with directions and a map of roadworks across Greater Manchester, is on the Rochdale Borough Council website.
